blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Approximately 1.25 million passengers are expected to pass through Ninoy Aquino International Airport (NAIA) during the Undas holiday travel rush from October 27 to November 4, prompting airport operator New NAIA Infra Corp. (NNIC) to step up preparations for the busy period. These include round-the-clock monitoring, additional personnel and passenger assistance services, and tighter security measures to manage the expected influx. October 30 is projected to be the busiest day, with around 149,000 passengers.
